title: Engram transport: process handoff returned before request enqueue has no atomic retirement fence (timeout/config/shutdown can retire the child between acquire and send)
outcome: A request that has acquired an Engram child process either is enqueued on that child before any retirement can take effect, or is cleanly refused and re-acquires a live child. A concurrent background timeout, configuration change or shutdown can no longer retire the child between the Arc handoff and the actual send. This is proven by a deterministic barrier test, not by timing. The exact pending key and unknown outcome are preserved, with no blind write retry.
acceptance: Engram transport: process handoff returned before request enqueue has no atomic retirement fence (timeout/config/shutdown can retire the child between acquire and send) is done
